name: @hasna/files
description: Agent-first file management — index local folders and S3 buckets, sync Google Drive, tag, search, and retrieve files via CLI + MCP

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:sdk && bun run build:dashboard && bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external @aws-sdk/* --external pg && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external @aws-sdk/* --external pg && bun build src/server/index.ts src/server/migrate.ts src/server/file-content-worker.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external @aws-sdk/* --external pg && bun build src/index.ts src/sdk/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @aws-sdk/* --external pg && bun build src/lib/path.ts --outfile dist/path.js --target bun && bun build src/s3.ts --outfile dist/s3.js --target bun --external @aws-sdk/* && bun run build:types
scripts.build:service: bun build src/server/index.ts src/server/migrate.ts src/server/file-content-worker.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external @aws-sdk/* --external pg
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
scripts.build:server: bun build src/server/index.ts src/server/file-content-worker.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @aws-sdk/* && bun build src/lib/path.ts --outfile dist/path.js --target bun && bun build src/s3.ts --outfile dist/s3.js --target bun --external @aws-sdk/* && bun run build:types
scripts.build:dashboard: cd dashboard && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run contracts:conformance && bun run clean && contracts no-cloud-scan .

author: hasna
